data.name: Impact_Formula
data.value: Score = 45% CPU + 40% memory + 15% disk I/O. Each part is the application's average load over the analyzed period (usage while running × share of time running), relative to a reference level: 15% of total CPU, 25% of physical memory, 5 MB/s of I/O. Levels: low below 10, moderate below 25, high below 50, very high from 50.
